title: Application under s.12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act

entries.averment: The domestic relationship is pleaded expressly with its basis (the jurisdictional fact).
At least one head of relief is sought.
Where a residence order under s.19 is sought, the shared household is pleaded.

source.ref: s.17, s.19 DV Act; S.R. Batra v. Taruna Batra / Satish Chander Ahuja v. Sneha Ahuja

entries.averment: Each head of relief sought (s.18 protection / s.19 residence / s.20 monetary / s.21 custody / s.22 compensation) has a supporting averment.
Abuse incidents are dated where possible and categorised (physical / sexual / verbal-emotional / economic).

source.ref: s.3 DV Act (definition of domestic violence)
